scope: New development analysis of existing frozen predictions; all five sequences already exposed
calibration_rule: Use calibration FP scores only, float32 nextafter exclusion; rerun actual NMS and matching and pass budget guard on every calibration condition BEFORE opening evaluation labels
reference_rule: Always use dense matches at the old common confidence as the evidence denominator, even after a selector-specific threshold changes; additionally report full-GT TP and FP. Threshold changes are not gate-only effects.
temporal_rule: Run of dense-hit and selected-miss GT track identities on adjacent evaluated image-grid queries. Break on missing GT, dense miss, grid gap or gap >1.5 times the full image-grid median. Single-loss observed span is zero. A dense miss or missing annotation is not observed recovery.
limitations: Calibration FPPI matching is not evaluation FPPI matching
Previously inspected sequences, no untouched-test claim
Weak transferred dense detector; full-population coverage remains mandatory
Offline candidate admission, no physical skip or energy claims
Loss-run spans are sampled observations, not continuous blindness, physical risk or absolute timely-detection guarantees
No new training or importance algorithm
